title: Slavoj Žižek — Why You Feel It, And Who Decided #Shorts
description:
Behind Slavoj Žižek sits an animal brain negotiating with a story it tells itself. Žižek is a Global Distinguished Professor of German at New York University, professor of philosophy and psychoanalysis at the European Graduate School and senior researcher at the Institute for Sociology and Philosophy at the University of Ljubljana. He was the international director of the Birkbeck Institute for the Humanities at the University of London from 2004 until September 2025.

The unconscious does not argue with Slavoj Žižek; it simply acts first. They are not communists, if 'communism' means the system which deservedly collapsed in 1990—and remember that the communists who are still in power today run the most ruthless capitalism (in China). ... The only sense in which the protestors are 'communists' is that they care for the commons—the commons of nature, of knowledge—which are threatened by the system.
